name: Vultr Object Storage
description: S3-compatible Vultr Object Storage: manage buckets and list, upload, download, and delete objects using AWS SigV4. Connect with the S3 hostname, access key, and secret key from your Object Storage subscription. The Vultr API bearer token is not an S3 credential.

credential_fields.name: s3_hostname
credential_fields.label: S3 Hostname
credential_fields.description: Copy s3_hostname from the subscription S3 Credentials, for example ewr1.vultrobjects.com. Enter only the hostname, without https://, a bucket name, or a path.

credential_fields.name: access_key_id
credential_fields.label: S3 Access Key
credential_fields.description: The subscription s3_access_key from Vultr Console > Cloud Storage > Object Storage > Overview > S3 Credentials, or the Vultr integration object_storage_get tool.

credential_fields.name: region
credential_fields.label: Signing Region
credential_fields.description: AWS SigV4 signing region. Vultr documents that the region is ignored; keep us-east-1 unless your endpoint requires another value.

tools.name: list_buckets
tools.description: List buckets visible to these S3 credentials. Returns an S3 XML response.

tools.name: create_bucket
tools.description: Create a bucket on the configured Vultr Object Storage endpoint.

tools.name: delete_bucket
tools.description: Delete an empty bucket. Non-empty buckets must have their objects and versions removed first.

tools.name: list_objects
tools.description: List objects using ListObjectsV2. Returns XML with Contents, IsTruncated, and NextContinuationToken. Pass the continuation token to fetch the next page.

prefix.description: Only keys starting with this prefix.

delimiter.description: Use / to group keys into CommonPrefixes.

continuation-token.description: NextContinuationToken returned by the previous page.

max-keys.description: Maximum objects per page, up to 1000.

tools.name: put_object
tools.description: Upload or replace an object in a single PUT. Pass body as plain text, or a binary envelope/blob reference for files. Binary uploads use the envelope MIME type; plain text uses text/plain. Multipart uploads are not provided.

key.description: Object key, including any folder prefix.

body.description: Plain text string or a runtime binary envelope {"_binary":true,"base64":"...","mimeType":"application/octet-stream"}; blob references are rehydrated by the runtime.

tools.name: get_object
tools.description: Download an object. The runtime returns text/JSON or a binary envelope according to its content type and applies its configured response-size limits.

key.description: Object key, including any folder prefix.

tools.name: delete_object
tools.description: Delete an object. On versioned buckets this creates a delete marker; it does not purge older versions.

key.description: Object key, including any folder prefix.
